description: Rule is the Schema for the rules API

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

checkType.description:
What type of check will this rule execute:
Platform, Node or none (represented by an empty string)
For CustomRules, only Platform is supported.

expression.description: Expression is the CEL expression to evaluate (required when scannerType=CEL)

failureReason.description: FailureReason is displayed when a CEL rule evaluation fails

inputs.description: Inputs defines the Kubernetes resources that need to be fetched before evaluating the expression

kubernetesInputSpec.description: KubernetesInputSpec is the specification of the Kubernetes resource to fetch

group.description: Group is the API group (e.g., "apps", "" for core resources)

resource.description:
Resource is the resource type (e.g., "pods", "configmaps")
Use the plural form of the resource

resourceName.description:
ResourceName is the specific resource name
Leave empty to fetch all resources of this type

resourceNamespace.description:
ResourceNamespace is the namespace to search in
Leave empty for cluster-scoped resources or to search all namespaces

name.description: Name is the variable name used to reference this resource in the CEL expression

instructions.description: Instructions for auditing this specific rule

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

scannerType.description:
ScannerType denotes which scanner evaluates this rule.
All rules must have an explicit scanner type set by the parser or user.

warning.description: A discretionary warning about the of the Rule
